title: Community wall site block: a read-only wall feed for websites and the builder
detail: A new additive site block key that renders the Space's public wall read-only (latest posts, a link into the app to join the conversation), available to sites and the builder. SpaceCommunity stays the topic Circles list. The site theme never styles the member wall (theme fence), the block reads through space_wall_feed as anon, and only walls anyone may read render it. Needs a design render before code (current vs proposed).

verify.note: Passes when the site block registry carries a SpaceWall block.
